pseudomonilicaryon-anser.reason: No species-specific NCBI DNA record was found under Pseudomonilicaryon anser or the reviewed historical names Dileptus anser and Dileptus cygnus. No related-species sequence is substituted.

selectionPolicy: Match the NCBI species name or documented synonym; source taxon must be that species or a verified descendant. Prefer complete mitochondrial RefSeq records for animals, plastid markers for plants, ribosomal DNA for fungi and microbes. Only deposited DNA intervals of 200–35,000 bp are bundled. This is not a claim to supply complete nuclear genomes or all available sequences.
